name: paxos-law12-alpha-v4
cmd: bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null && bun research/verify-all/paxos-law12-alpha.ts v4 && bash research/verify-all/check-lean.sh /tmp/paxos-law12-alpha-v4/alpha-check.lean; rc=$?; tar -cJf /tmp/paxos-law12-alpha-v4/artifacts.tar.xz -C /tmp/paxos-law12-alpha-v4 alpha.packet.json alpha-check.lean; echo ARTIFACTS_BEGIN; base64 -w0 /tmp/paxos-law12-alpha-v4/artifacts.tar.xz; echo; echo ARTIFACTS_END; exit $rc
